Also `t(err.message)` will render raw server error keys like "booking_not_found" or "you_do_not_have_permission" untranslated (these keys are not in the locale JSON additions in this diff), showing raw internals to users. This is a verifiable correctness defect introduced by the new file.

record.issue_text: Client toast renders raw error internals in AddGuestsDialog.tsx:40-42: `t(err.message)` renders untranslated keys to the user and the `message || t(...)` fallback never triggers since the template string is always truthy

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog` the `onError` handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` and then calls `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), ...)`. Because `message` is always a non-empty string (even when `err.data?.code` is undefined), the fallback can never trigger, and users may see `undefined: <...>` plus potentially unlocalized/raw `err.message` content if it isn’t a valid i18n key.
